tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs using complete criteria and update the jobs page. Each call replaces the current search state; omitted fields use defaults. Returns normalized criteria, total count, and lightweight results.

query.description: Text matched against job title, company, description, and skills.

location.description: City used as the geographic search center.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometers around location. Allowed values: 10, 25, 50, 100, 200. Omit to use 25 km when a location is provided.

salaryMin.description: Minimum acceptable monthly gross salary in USD.

limit.description: Maximum number of lightweight results to return.

tools.name: highlight_job
tools.description: Highlight a specific job offer in the current results whenever the user refers to, selects, asks about, or wants to focus on that offer. Focuses its map marker and opens its preview without changing filters. Requires a visible job ID.

jobId.description: The exact job identifier from the current search results returned by search_jobs.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Show an agent-authored comparison of two to five jobs. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Supports a badge, note, and one highlighted recommendation per offer. Does not modify jobs.

title.description: Optional drawer heading shown above the comparison. Defaults to "Offer comparison" when omitted.

summary.description: Overall agent analysis or recommendation shown at the top of the drawer. Maximum 2,000 characters.

jobId.description: The unique job identifier returned by search_jobs, get_jobs, or get_saved_jobs (for example, job-001).

badge.description: Optional free-text badge for this offer (for example, najlepsza, interesujaca, rozwojowa). Omit when no badge is needed.

note.description: Optional short note explaining why this badge or ranking applies to this offer. Maximum 500 characters.

highlighted.description: When true, visually emphasize this offer with an animated gradient border and star icon. Use for the single primary recommendation; at most one offer may be highlighted.

offers.description: Two to five offers to compare. Each entry needs a jobId and may include an optional badge and note.

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Return complete job records for one to twenty IDs in input order. Missing offers are marked per item. Does not change application state.

jobIds.description: One to twenty unique job identifiers returned by search_jobs.

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's saved jobs. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Returns IDs and lightweight details; use get_jobs for full records. Does not change state.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save one job for the signed-in user. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Requires a jobId from search_jobs or get_jobs and is idempotent.

jobId.description: The unique job identifier returned by search_jobs or get_jobs (for example, job-001).

tools.name: unsave_job
tools.description: Remove one saved job for the signed-in user. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. It is idempotent and does not delete applications.

jobId.description: The unique job identifier returned by search_jobs or get_jobs (for example, job-001).

tools.name: apply_job
tools.description: Open a job application dialog with an optional message. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Requires sign-in and a chosen job. The user must review and submit; this tool never submits.

jobId.description: The unique job identifier returned by search_jobs or get_jobs (for example, job-001).

note.description: Optional message pre-filled in the apply dialog for the user to review before submitting. Maximum 2,000 characters; omit when no note is needed.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in candidate profile. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Returns identity, experience, skills, work history, and job preferences without changing state.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update the signed-in candidate profile. Use this tool instead of interacting with the page UI or DOM. Omitted fields stay unchanged; arrays replace the whole field and [] clears it. Persists immediately.

firstName.description: Candidate first name. Pass an empty string to clear it.

lastName.description: Candidate last name. Pass an empty string to clear it.

headline.description: Short professional headline. Pass an empty string to clear it.

endDate.description: End month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for a current role.

current.description: Whether this is the current role. Defaults to false.

description.description: Optional summary of responsibilities or achievements.

workHistory.description: Complete replacement for work history. Pass [] to clear all entries; every entry needs company, title, and startDate.

years.description: Whole years of experience, from 1 to 50.

skills.description: Complete replacement for skills. Pass [] to clear all skills.

preferredRoles.description: Complete replacement for preferred role names. Pass [] to clear them.

preferredSeniorities.description: Complete replacement for preferred seniority levels. Allowed: junior, regular, senior, expert. Pass [] to clear.

preferredLocations.description: Complete replacement for preferred city names. Pass [] to clear them.

workplacePreferences.description: Complete replacement for workplace preferences. Allowed: remote, hybrid, onsite. Pass [] to clear.

contractPreferences.description: Complete replacement for contract preferences. Allowed: b2b, employment, service-contract, internship. Pass [] to clear.

min.description: Minimum monthly salary. Omit or pass 0 when no minimum is required.

currency.description: Salary currency: USD, EUR, or PLN.

salaryExpectation.description: Salary expectation. Supplying this object replaces the current salary expectation.

preferences.description: Additional free-text job preferences. Pass an empty string to clear them.
